name: Claude-Mem OpenClaw Plugin — Setup Guide
tagline_zh: 你的智能体每次对话都失忆？装上它，自动压缩全程记录，下次自动注入相关回忆，像给AI装了个长期大脑。
tagline_en: Your agent forgets every session? This plugin auto-compresses all activity and injects relevant memory next.
desc_en: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant
why_zh: 同类工具只存原始日志，它用AI压缩提炼，按场景精准召回，越用越懂你。
why_en: Unlike raw-log stores, it AI-compresses and contextually recalls—gets smarter with every session.
